title: A Blackrock's Debt

texts.details:
I was Blackrock, once. I was one of Blackhand's own lieutenants. I left when I saw what my clan's chiefs were: petty lords who sent our sons to die for their rivalries. I do not say this to boast of it.

What is left of the Blackrock follows Rend, Blackhand's son, who calls himself Warchief and serves a dragon. They are the Horde as it was, $N. They shame us.

One of them is held in the humans' prison in Stormwind: Targorr the Dread, executioner to their chieftain in the Redridge Mountains. The humans have sentenced him and will not carry it out. Some lord of theirs finds him useful. I do not. Go into that prison and finish it.
texts.objectives: Kill Targorr the Dread in the Stockade, beneath Stormwind, then return to Eitrigg in Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.
texts.progress: The prison is in the heart of the human city. The prisoners have risen and hold it. You will not go unnoticed, and you should not go alone.
texts.completion:
Then one more of the old Horde's butchers is gone, and no human lord will make a counter of him.

I killed for Blackhand. I know what Targorr was, because I stood beside a hundred like him. It took me half my life to walk away.

The Warchief gives every orc that chance. Targorr never wanted it. Remember the difference, $N.

idea: The Stockade, 1 of 2 for the Horde: Eitrigg was a Blackrock lieutenant of Blackhand who left the Horde over his clan's leaders; Targorr the Dread, executioner under Gath'Ilzogg, is held under a death sentence a noble delays. Invented: that Eitrigg wants him dead.
